name: mirage
text:
PropLine is running well. Both sockets are live: the odds board is 0 s behind, the signals socket 1 s behind, delay about 1 s, 214 book boards fresh, 8 of 8 live games tracked, 150 game-state pushes. Plan: Streaming Lite, 250,000 requests a day. One oddity: the separate +EV sweep shows 0 rows right now; the stream's own +EV pushes (238) are flowing. I will look at it next run.

What PropLine offers, and where Vigilant stands:
USED NOW
1. Odds for 200+ books, pregame and live, over the stream. This is the main fair-line source.
2. Pinnacle prices, which is why PropLine is one of the two majors now.
3. Player props and alternate lines.
4. Line movement, steam and line-added or pulled pushes. These are logged for study.
5. Live game state (score, clock), used as the live lane's third score source. It runs about 18 s behind the league.
6. Closing and opening lines and CLV. The daily archive grades our bets against Pinnacle's close.
7. +EV against Novig (/ev) and hit-rate trends (/trends).
8. Same-game parlay quotes. Novig paid the most on 26 of 40 slips, and a study is running.
9. Resolved-prop history, used for tuning.

TRIED, NOT BUILT
- /parlay/price: Novig's own parlay quote is -4% to -8% EV (median -5.8%) against the fair price. Independent parlays at Novig are a cost, so I'm not building a scanner on it.
- /bets/settle: a second grader that got 17 of 17 test bets right, including alternate lines and halves our box-score grader can't settle. Next build, as a fallback grader.
- /ev/calc: an independent EV check. Low value, since we price our own fair.
- Kalshi and Polymarket order-book depth history: usable for a Kalshi fill-odds study.
- /ids/lookup: event id crosswalk, only worth building if grading shows unmatched games.
- /scores with clock and last play: a REST fallback for live state when the socket is down.

SKIPPED
- Bet links to other books (we bet only at Novig and Kalshi).
- Discord webhooks.
- Availability pushes (need the higher tier).
- DFS tiers, referees, futures.
- Enterprise bulk exports.

FOR YOU: their MCP server (mcp.prop-line.com), a CLI and a Python SDK. They are the quickest way to poke at the API yourself.

Details: research/propline_unused_features_2026-11-17.md. Next I'll build the /bets/settle fallback grader and check the idle +EV sweep.
